about: The software and data the Cloud Code module MuseumPuzzleServer carries (the output Unity's Deployment window uploads, server/CloudCode/DEPLOY.md), as the NuGet packages' own licence files and nuspecs give them (read from the NuGet cache on 2026-10-26). None of it is in the game's builds: the game's own record is unity/Packages/licences.json. The module runs on Unity's servers and is shown to no player, so nothing here asks for a notice on the credits card; the record is for the owner and the legal reading (docs/research/server-v1.md section 6.2). Packages used only by the tests (xunit, the test SDK, coverlet) are not in the module and are not listed.

packages.inTheModule: the function attribute, the execution context and the setup interface (Endpoints/PurchaseModule.cs)
the game API client: Cloud Save and the Secret Manager (Platform/UgsServerStore.cs, Platform/UgsSecrets.cs)
